risks.risk: Console brand/model may not be Xbox One (pricing depends heavily on exact model and generation).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model number (rear sticker) and the front panel branding if visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified black game console (worst-case: older/unknown model) with limited confidence.

risks.risk: Power/adaptor issue could mean the console may not power on reliably or may require replacement parts.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console powering on from the provided adaptor and staying on (including boot to dashboard).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working / power-uncertain until proven.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, not included, or not the claimed titles (including FC).
risks.proof: Photos of all 6 game cases/discs (or a screenshot/list showing titles) laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming any games are included.

risks.risk: Controller may have drift, dead buttons, or poor responsiveness; also may not be the only controller included.
risks.proof: Video clip of controller connected and a quick input test (moving sticks, pressing all buttons) plus showing it in-game/menu response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst-case: needs replacement).

risks.risk: Ports/network/disc drive may be faulty even if the console looks intact.
risks.proof: Video clip testing HDMI output (TV shows dashboard), at least one USB device, and network connection (Wi‑Fi/Ethernet) if applicable.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility (UK receipt/region) may affect availability of services or disc compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of region/model/serial label and a quick sign-in/network check showing it connects.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk treated as worst-case.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console rear label showing brand, exact model, and serial number.
Video showing the console powering on using the provided adaptor and reaching the dashboard.
Photos of all included games (6) showing titles (and discs/cases).
Video showing controller input responsiveness (no drift) and that it works fully in menus/games.
Video testing HDMI output and at least one other port (USB), plus network connection if possible.
Photo of the UK receipt (or at least the receipt details) and confirmation of what accessories are included (power cable/adaptor, HDMI/AV, controller charging cable, etc.).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a black game console with a controller, but the exact Xbox One model and the key risk (adaptor/power issue) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without proof of power-on functionality and exact model, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
